analysis.issue: Prior agents struggled with trigger detection, particularly for implicit cases (eval-2) where no explicit 'walk me through' or 'on mobile' signal exists but the task is clearly manual multi-step work that benefits from easy-mode.
analysis.solution: Two-tier trigger heuristics: explicit signals (high confidence) and implicit patterns (detect manual procedures without explicit signals).

implicit_patterns: Multi-step manual procedures (especially when order matters or error recovery is needed)
Tasks requiring copying values, pasting tokens, or clicking through multiple pages
Cloud identity/secret management (IAM, API keys, environment variables)
trigger_heuristics.decision_logic: Invoke easy-mode if: (1) ANY explicit signal is present, OR (2) Task is manual multi-step work that user cannot do programmatically and involves copying/pasting/clicking.

eval_classifications.name: rotate-aws-ci-keys
eval_classifications.note: No explicit 'walk me through' but matches implicit pattern: multi-step IAM key rotation with strict sequencing (create new before deleting old). User cannot automate the AWS console navigation.

recommendations.update_skill_description: Clarify that easy-mode should be invoked not only on explicit 'walk me through' but also for implicit cases: any manual procedure involving cloud consoles, copy/paste workflows, or multi-step setup without automation.
recommendations.confidence_threshold: Invoke if confidence >= 0.9 (covers both explicit and high-confidence implicit)
recommendations.monitoring: Track cases where easy-mode was not invoked but should have been (false negatives) vs invoked unnecessarily (false positives)
